- Pulse AI inside Pulse: local chat (llama.cpp) and timed lyrics (whisper.cpp) on arm64 phones with Android 9+; models download into Download/PulseAI.
- Music: the Sonic look (a turntable in glowing lines); the lyrics' AI button makes timed lyrics.
- Keyboard: on-device neural model (Turkish and English) weighs corrections by the sentence; tuned to the owner's slips; AI fix; blocked suggestions list; new statistics screen.
- Premium is the Play purchase only; the foss build is unchanged.
- Setup: Continue always works, required and optional permissions named; What's new after updates.
- Files: tools go back where they were opened; pull to refresh. Calculator: numbers fit and are grouped.
- Icons: icon-pack search and an icon maker for the extra apps; Palette: icon for one app.
- PDF: tap printed text to edit it; saved copies stay real PDF text.
